\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{cleveref}
\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}
\newtheorem{exercise}{Exercise}
\crefname{exercise}{Exercise}{Exercises}
\begin{document}
\begin{proposition}
  \label{prop:chap:sheaves:sec:intro:injectivity of restriction maps}
  Restriction is injective.
\end{proposition}
\begin{proposition}
  \label{prop:chap:sheaves:sec:intro:image of restriction maps}
  The image is the equalizer.
\end{proposition}
\begin{exercise}
  \label{exercise:chap:sheaves:sec:intro:complete proof representables are sheaves}
  Prove
  \Cref{prop:chap:sheaves:sec:intro:injectivity of restriction maps,prop:chap:sheaves:sec:intro:image of restriction maps}.
\end{exercise}
See
\cref{exercise:chap:sheaves:sec:intro:complete proof representables are sheaves}.
\end{document}
